source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: You ask an agent to summarize a README. It displays a file-reading command, but no tool result appears. What should you check next?

options.text: Whether the harness actually ran the file-reading tool
options.feedback: You need evidence that the requested file was read before treating the summary as grounded in its contents.

options.text: Whether the command was phrased with enough confidence
options.feedback: More confident language does not establish that the operation was executed.

options.text: Whether the answer contains a sufficiently large word count
options.feedback: Length does not show that the agent obtained the source material.

options.text: Whether the model knows the general purpose of README files
options.feedback: General knowledge may help interpret a file, but it does not establish access to this particular file.
